summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that Nasdaq granted it an additional 180-day period, until January 25, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1 minimum bid price requirement. The company initially failed to meet the requirement and did not cure the deficiency during the first compliance period ending July 28, 2026. To regain compliance, shares must close at or above $1 for 10 consecutive trading days. This filing signals a potential delisting risk; the next milestone is achieving price compliance before the deadline.
